# awesome-3d-agents

> A curated list of 3D agent tooling, engines and embeds.

awesome-3d-agents is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/awesome-3d-agents/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference
- [Contents](https://github.com/nirholas/awesome-3d-agents/blob/HEAD/README.md#contents)
- [Text and image to 3D](https://github.com/nirholas/awesome-3d-agents/blob/HEAD/README.md#text-and-image-to-3d)
- [Photos and video to 3D](https://github.com/nirholas/awesome-3d-agents/blob/HEAD/README.md#photos-and-video-to-3d)
- [Avatars and characters](https://github.com/nirholas/awesome-3d-agents/blob/HEAD/README.md#avatars-and-characters)
- [Rigging and retargeting](https://github.com/nirholas/awesome-3d-agents/blob/HEAD/README.md#rigging-and-retargeting)
- [Motion and animation](https://github.com/nirholas/awesome-3d-agents/blob/HEAD/README.md#motion-and-animation)
- [Texturing and materials](https://github.com/nirholas/awesome-3d-agents/blob/HEAD/README.md#texturing-and-materials)
- [Faces, lipsync, and voice](https://github.com/nirholas/awesome-3d-agents/blob/HEAD/README.md#faces-lipsync-and-voice)
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/awesome-3d-agents/blob/HEAD/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
- [Full text for LLMs](https://github.com/nirholas/awesome-3d-agents/blob/HEAD/llms-full.txt): the README inlined
